why: The TDD + verification gates are the plugin's costliest behavioural bet. arXiv:2603.17973 found procedural TDD instructions raised regressions on a 30B model; arXiv:2605.26731 found reasoning-tier models score best under a strict harness. This case measures what is actually detectable at this scale: solve rate against a held-out execution check, regression on a sentinel that already passed, and cost per solved task.
